development.owner_decision: One controlled revision is approved as eligible because complete retained evidence supports correction of all agreed material errors.
development.eligibility_rule: Proceed only after the initial response is valid, protected semantic coverage review passes, the code-derived decision is REVISE and checker guidance accurately covers scope, population/number and programme-end errors.
development.recheck_rule: Recheck the complete revised summary. Any mandatory failure or unresolved uncertainty becomes HOLD and blocks evaluation.

evaluation.eligibility_rule: A listed case proceeds only when the initial checker response is valid, the code-derived decision is REVISE and guidance is specific, source-bound and valid. Listing does not override HOLD or invalid output.
